pr_title: Fix parental encryption status with EQUALS constraint
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/osquery/osquery/issues/7314

When an EQUALS constraint is applied to the disk_encryption virtual table,
the parent device also needs to be queried. The EQUALS constraint is applied
by the user by including `WHERE name=` in the query. It's also applied
implicitly by JOINing on the table.

issue_context.title: Parental encryption status not applied with table joins on mounts and disk_encryption
issue_context.body:

# Bug report

<!--
Please follow this template.
Before submitting an issue search for duplicates.
-->

### What operating system and version are you using?

<!--
You can run the command bellow. Paste result within a code block.

osqueryi --line "SELECT version, build, platform FROM os_version;"
-->
```
osqueryi --line "SELECT version, build, platform FROM os_version;"
 version = 20.04 LTS
   build = 
platform = pop
```

### What version of osquery are you using?

<!--
You can run the line bellow. Paste the result within a code block.

osqueryi --line "SELECT version from osquery_info;"
-->
```
osqueryi --line "SELECT version from osquery_info;"
version = 5.0.1
```

### What steps did you take to reproduce the issue?

Default install of Pop_OS, encrypting the disk using default cryptsetup/LVM+LUKS. This would also apply to Ubuntu, and others in this configuration.

Based on https://github.com/osquery/osquery/pull/3551 I expected to see the encrypted bit carry over when JOINING with another table to check if the root partition is encrypted.

```
user@pop-os:~$ sudo osqueryi "SELECT name, encrypted, type FROM disk_encryption WHERE name NOT LIKE '%loop%'"
[sudo] password for user: 
  Configuration setting "activation/vdo_pool_autoextend_threshold" unknown.
  Configuration setting "global/support_mirrored_mirror_log" unknown.
  Configuration setting "global/event_activation" unknown.
  Configuration setting "devices/scan_lvs" unknown.
  Configuration setting "devices/allow_mixed_block_sizes" unknown.
+-----------+-----------+-----------------------+
| name      | encrypted | type                  |
+-----------+-----------+-----------------------+
| /dev/sda  | 0         |                       |
| /dev/sda1 | 0         |                       |
| /dev/sda2 | 0         |                       |
| /dev/sda3 | 0         |                       |
| /dev/sr0  | 0         |                       |
| /dev/dm-0 | 1         | aes-xts-plain64       |
| /dev/dm-1 | 1         | aes-xts-plain64       |
| /dev/dm-2 | 1         | PLAIN-aes-xts-plain64 |
+-----------+-----------+-----------------------+
user@pop-os:~$ sudo osqueryi "SELECT device, device_alias, path FROM mounts WHERE device LIKE '/dev/%'"
+-----------------------+--------------+-------+
| device                | device_alias | path  |
+-----------------------+--------------+-------+
| /dev/mapper/data-root | /dev/dm-1    | /     |
| /dev/sda1             | /dev/sda1    | /boot |
+-----------------------+--------------+-------+
```

### What did you expect to see?

The `/dev/mapper/data-root` device should show as encrypted.

```
user@pop-os:~$ sudo osqueryi "SELECT device, device_alias, path, encrypted FROM mounts INNER JOIN disk_encryption ON mounts.device_alias = disk_encryption.name WHERE mounts.device LIKE '/dev/%'"
...
+-----------------------+--------------+-------+-----------+
| device                | device_alias | path  | encrypted |
+-----------------------+--------------+-------+-----------+
| /dev/mapper/data-root | /dev/dm-1    | /     | 1         |
| /dev/sda1             | /dev/sda1    | /boot | 0         |
+-----------------------+--------------+-------+-----------+
```

### What did you see instead?

No devices showed as encrypted.

```
user@pop-os:~$ sudo osqueryi "SELECT device, device_alias, path, encrypted FROM mounts INNER JOIN disk_encryption ON mounts.device_alias = disk_encryption.name WHERE mounts.device LIKE '/dev/%'"
  Configuration setting "activation/vdo_pool_autoextend_threshold" unknown.

  Configuration setting "global/event_activation" unknown.

  Configuration setting "devices/allow_mixed_block_sizes" unknown.
+-----------------------+--------------+-------+-----------+
| device                | device_alias | path  | encrypted |
+-----------------------+--------------+-------+-----------+
| /dev/mapper/data-root | /dev/dm-1    | /     | 0         |
| /dev/sda1             | /dev/sda1    | /boot | 0         |
+-----------------------+--------------+-------+-----------+
```
